$comment: Pieces of the Dungeon Essential Kit (Rakshaan, CC-BY 4.0; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for scripts/art/kit/render_kit.py. sizePx at the Lords of Pain decor scale (29.6 px per tile): the cage about 1.2 tiles across (the void's low box, DECOR_BOX.columnBroken), the chains about 1.7 tiles long, the candle chandelier (its chain cut off by keepHeight, so it lies fallen on the floor) about 2 tiles across. flatten: lying chains (the kit's are draped up a wall). Iron keeps more of its brightness than stone and wood, or a 2 px chain vanishes on the dark floors. The bookcase (docs/BOOKSHELVES.md) at world scale (unitsPerTile 125: 0.91 x 0.38 tiles, 1.78 tall), facing +X (rotZ 180, _x) and +Z (rotZ 90, _z), pivot the cell centre half a tile in front of its back (pivotAt); sunSide mirrors the sun for the +X facing, whose shelves the usual sun leaves in shadow, so both facings read alike.
